Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for WCD Dhamtari Security Guard/ Night Guard Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the walk-in interview for WCD Dhamtari Security Guard/Night Guard posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the WCD Dhamtari Security Guard/Night Guard posts is scheduled for 11th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Security Guard/Night Guard position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 8th Class from a recognized board and possess a minimum of 2 years of experience as a security guard. Preference will be given to ex-servicemen or retirees from semi-military forces.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Security Guard/Night Guard role?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per state government rules, potentially up to 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Security Guard/Night Guard position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 11,360 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Security Guard/Night Guard post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Security Guard/Night Guard position at the Women and Child Development Department Dhamtari.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the WCD Dhamtari Security Guard/Night Guard recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve the creation of a Merit List followed by a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the WCD Dhamtari office. Specific timings should be confirmed from the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.
